mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital flows into risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5% over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative equity returns as corporate earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP growth below 0.5% and monthly housing starts decline below 0.3% indicate weakening consumer demand, causing equity sell-offs due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are below thresholds over any 24-month window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annually) combined with rising Fed funds rates creates a monetary tightening regime that increases equity discount rates and produces negative forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rising over any 18-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index decline below 105.0 signals weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate profit margins and triggering negative equity returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth falling below 0.1% monthly indicates labor market stagnation, reducing consumer spending power and causing negative equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.1% over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous residential fixed investment decline below 0.2% and housing starts decline below 0.1% signal housing market collapse, reducing consumer wealth and triggering negative equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are below thresholds over any 12-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) with rising Fed funds rates creates policy tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, producing negative returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rising over any 24-month window.
